name: pulse-verity
description: Signed, verifiable crypto index prices for 4,800+ assets. Try BTC, ETH and SOL without an API key. Read-only tools over the Pulse Verity Index API, plus local signature verification.
long_description:
Every price the Pulse Verity Index publishes is signed with ECDSA P-256 and can be verified against a public key. This extension gives Claude five read-only tools: the current signed price for one symbol, a batch of up to 100 symbols, the asset catalogue with coverage and cadence, the recorded print nearest a timestamp, and an offline verifier for any signed print.

No API key is required to start. Without one the extension serves real, signed current prices for BTC, ETH and SOL. A free developer key from https://thepulse.markets/developers unlocks the full catalogue, batch reads and settlement prints, subject to usage limits. Update frequency and availability vary by asset.

pulse_api_key.title: Pulse API key (optional)
pulse_api_key.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the free sample (BTC, ETH, SOL). A free key starting with pidx_ from https://thepulse.markets/developers unlocks 4,800+ assets (60 requests a minute, no card).
